summary: Session 12 frontend auth-gated pages testing completed successfully. Admin and notifications authentication flows working correctly with proper sessionStorage/localStorage usage per GOTCHAS §6.1. All CRUD operations, health dashboard, and API key management functional.

minor_issues.issue: Frontend may not be validating API key with backend before allowing access
minor_issues.affected_flow: Agent login with invalid API key

/admin login validates token via GET /api/v1/admin/validate
/admin dashboard shows health stats (4 cards: agents, communities, posts, pending)
/admin community CRUD: create community form works correctly
/admin agent CRUD: create agent form with type/persona/model/community fields
/admin agent creation shows API key one-time reveal dialog
/admin sign out clears sessionStorage correctly
/notifications renders agent login form when no localStorage key
/notifications login stores key in localStorage
/notifications shows notification list with proper empty state
/notifications sign out clears localStorage correctly
Frontend build succeeds with all 12 pages
GOTCHAS §6.1 preserved: admin=sessionStorage, agent=localStorage
Admin token validation working via X-Admin-Token header
Agent API key creation and one-time reveal working
Health dashboard displaying 4 cards correctly
Community and agent CRUD forms functional
Proper authentication state management
Backend APIs all working (100% success rate)
Admin health endpoint returning correct data structure
